basis_invariant_probe.method: five-fold orbit-grouped ridge least-squares probe on the 34 source-report activations

limitations: retrospective analysis of one checkpoint and one engineered bank
ridge scores are a cross-validated linear probe, not a causal direction
positive mixtures preserve nonnegativity but not native sparsity or independence
permuted labels preserve prevalence but not logical structure

prevalence_matched_permuted_labels.note: each column preserves the exact assignment-label prevalence but destroys row semantics

reference_comparisons.inferential_status: retrospective descriptive; reference families are not exchangeability nulls

scope: retrospective zero-forward analysis of retained protected-study arrays

supersedes.reason: v1 indexed column zero instead of the diagonal of the label-by-score probe AUROC matrix; other sections are unaffected
